name: ✖️ Times Tables Masters
desc:
Practice your times tables!
This game goes up to twelve times tables, which is the average requirement for a young teenager during school.

Leave a Like 👍 and favourite⭐ to come back to the game later.

More Maths Practice Games? Play Now:
